description: RATCHET (cloister-17e502): subprocess spawning in the execution runtime path must not grow. execution/v1 over UDS replaces it; the remaining sites are the compatibility fallback. Baseline 13 across compatibility-client, install-compatibility, runtime, runtime-storage-init. A ratchet not a ban, because zero is blocked on LLO publishing the contract — but every new spawn is a step away from the thing we are landing. Lower the baseline when you delete one; never raise it.
run: BASE=13; N=$(grep -rnE 'spawnSync|spawn\(|execSync|execFile' cli/lib/runtime cli/commands/runtime.mjs cli/commands/runtime-storage-init.mjs 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$N" -gt "$BASE" ]; then echo "runtime subprocess sites grew: $N > $BASE (baseline)"; grep -rnE 'spawnSync|spawn\(|execSync|execFile' cli/lib/runtime cli/commands/runtime.mjs cli/commands/runtime-storage-init.mjs; echo; echo 'Reach LLO through execution/v1 over UDS (cli/lib/runtime/llo-client.mjs), not a subprocess. Per ADR-0063.'; exit 1; fi; if [ "$N" -lt "$BASE" ]; then echo "ratchet loosened: $N < $BASE — lower BASE in this rule to $N to lock the win in"; exit 1; fi; echo "runtime subprocess sites: $N (at baseline)"
